newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada employment insurance claims rise in March.
newsitem.headline: Canada employment insurance claims rise in March.

text.p: The number of Canadians applying for employment insurance benefits in March rose 0.7 percent to 228,000 from February, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
Increased claims were registered in Alberta, Quebec and British Columbia, while claims in Ontario decreased, the federal agency said.
StatsCan said 591,000 Canadians received regular employment insurance benefits in March, down 1.1 percent from February.
This was the sixth consecutive decline, led by a 2.6 percent drop in Ontario, StatsCan said.
Regular benefit payments declined for the third consecutive month, dropping 1.0 percent to C$747 million.
